question: Which of these is the westernmost inhabited village in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ghuar Mota**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Ghuar Mota** is the westernmost inhabited village in India, located in the Kutch district of Gujarat.
 
• It is geographically situated near the Arabian Sea and lies close to the Indo-Pakistan border.
 
• This village is part of the Lakhpat taluka, which is known for its strategic location and historical significance.
 
• The region is sparsely populated, and its geographical significance stems from its position as India's westernmost settlement.
 
• Ghuar Mota holds strategic importance due to its proximity to the border and is part of the coastal surveillance system.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kutch District:**

 
 
• Kutch is the largest district in India, located in the state of Gujarat.
 
• The district is known for its white salt desert, known as the Great Rann of Kutch, and its cultural heritage.
 
• It shares a significant portion of India's western border with Pakistan.
 
 
 
• **Indo-Pakistan Border:**
 
 
• The border between India and Pakistan runs for approximately 3,323 kilometers.
 
• The western border areas, including Gujarat, are closely monitored for security purposes.
 
• The region is equipped with advanced surveillance systems to ensure national security.
 
 
 
• **Lakhpat Taluka:**
 
 
• Lakhpat taluka is a subdivision in the Kutch district and holds historical importance as a once-thriving port town.
 
• The taluka is sparsely populated and is known for its proximity to the westernmost point of India.
 
 
 
• **Westernmost Point of India:**
 
 
• The westernmost point of India is located in the Sir Creek area of Gujarat.
 
• Ghuar Mota is the westernmost inhabited village in India, while the uninhabited westernmost point lies further west.
